evidence.detail: rs/l/d/c, already reviewed as LoginScreen, constructs rs/l/d/e directly in its update-loading path, starts it as a Thread exactly once while update text is absent, and stores the resulting parsed strings on the same LoginScreen instance.
The thread opens the exact URL https://spawnpk.net/forums/index.php?/forum/10-updates/ and reads the forum HTML directly.
Its run method identifies '<span itemprop="name headline">' entries, extracts href links, decodes HTML entities, truncates long titles, formats date/title text and accumulates up to six update rows.
The parsed headline/link/summary strings and derived display height are written back exclusively through LoginScreen fields/accessors; no second UI or gameplay subsystem consumes the thread.

proposals.note: LoginUpdateFetcher is fixed by its exclusive LoginScreen ownership, exact SpawnPK updates-forum URL, headline/link HTML parser and one-shot Thread lifecycle. Confidence is 0.999.
